title: Samsung Releases New Feature Boost To Millions Of Galaxy Phones
summary: Samsung is enhancing its Galaxy phones with an upgraded Bixby powered by Perplexity AI, enabling natural language interaction to control settings and features, and introducing an AI-powered browser with agentic capabilities for more efficient online tasks.
sentiment_reason: The introduction of an upgraded Bixby and an AI-powered browser represents a positive development for Samsung's smartphones, offering enhanced user experience and innovative features.
